basis: Star’s fiscal Q4 earnings release was the earliest qualifying communication found. For the three months ended September 30, 2024, the consolidated GAAP table reports total sales of $240,331,000, including $155,943,000 of product sales and $84,388,000 of installations and services. Prior-year quarterly total sales were $266,937,000. The 95% threshold was $253,590,150, so reported sales were $13,259,150 below it. Both figures use Star’s reported consolidated perimeter, including acquisition effects.

coverage.detail: May 1, preceding earnings cycle. The 9.7% revenue decline to $666.0 million applied to fiscal Q2 ended March 31. The release gave no numeric Q4 sales outlook.
May 2, Q2 call transcript. Management reviewed first-half performance and discussed acquisitions and their valuation. It gave no consolidated sales figure or range for Q4.
July 18. Star declared a $0.1725 per-unit distribution for the June quarter. The release contained no September-quarter sales estimate.

July 31, immediately preceding earnings release. Q3 revenue rose 10.5% to $331.6 million. The explicit Q4 expectation concerned closing a roughly $35 million acquisition. The 19 million gallons cited were the target’s expected annual deliveries. Neither figure bounded Star’s Q4 sales.

August 1, Q3 call transcript. Management reiterated the acquisition price, annual gallons and expected Q4 closing. It reviewed Q3 and nine-month performance without giving a Q4 consolidated revenue forecast.
Star’s event archive dates the Q2 and Q3 calls to May 2 and August 1. Its next listed event was the December 5 Q4 results call. No intervening investor presentation is listed.
October 1. Star announced a credit facility with a $400 million revolver, rising to $475 million during heating season, and a $210 million term loan. The release gave no preliminary Q4 sales.
October 17. Star declared a $0.1725 per-unit distribution for the three months ended September 30. It disclosed no revenue for that quarter.
November 27. Star’s reproduced wire notice scheduled the results for after market close December 4 and the call for December 5. It contained no sales estimate.
December 4. Star’s original wire release reports the quarterly sales decline as 10.0% and supplies the precise consolidated table figures used above.
Item 2.02 independently confirms that Star issued the fiscal Q4 and full-year results release on December 4 and furnished it as Exhibit 99.1.

publication_date_evidence: The original GlobeNewswire release identifies Star Group, L.P. as the source and timestamps publication at 4:30 p.m. ET on December 4, 2024. Star’s Form 8-K confirms the same issuance date.
